translationRepairs: The relevant office memorialized to compose suburban and temple hymns; the emperor ordered Chancellor Chu Yuan, attendant Xie Tiao, attendant at leisure Kong Zhigui, Erudite Wang Xuanzhi, Zongming scholars Liu Rong, He Fajiong, and He Yanxiu — ten in all — to compose; only Chaozong's hymn was used.

The relevant office memorialized to compose suburban and temple hymns; the emperor ordered Chancellor Chu Yuan, attendant Xie Fei, attendant at leisure Kong Zhigui, Erudite Wang Xuanzhi, Zongming scholars Liu Rong, He Fajiong, and He Tanxiu — ten in all — to compose; only Chaozong's hymn was used.
Chinese 侍中謝朏 and 何曇秀 require Xie Fei and He Tanxiu; Xie Tiao and He Yanxiu misread those graphs, and the proposed literal otherwise matches the unit.
bright night's glow does not open the blind man's eyes.
Therefore mountain-breaking thunder does not start the deaf man's ear;
Unit s0184 is only 故破山之雷，不發聾夫之耳; the blind-eye English belongs to the next unit, and the proposed clause restores this couplet half accurately.
Someone presented Xiang's Linked Pearls; the emperor ordered Ren Xia to memorialize:
Bright night's glow does not open the blind elder's eyes.
Chinese 朗夜之輝，不開矇叟之目 closes the Linked Pearls couplet; the current idiomatic jumps ahead to the presentation narrative that begins only in s0186.
Someone presented Xiang's Linked Pearls to the emperor; the emperor ordered acting censor Ren Xia to memorialize:
Bright night's glow does not open the blind elder's eyes.
The same Chinese of s0185 has no Linked Pearls presentation or Ren Xia; the proposed literal restores the bright-night/blind-elder clause and leaves that narrative to s0186.
Your prisoner entered office twenty-odd years from coarse cloth, sunk in hardship without heaven's clarity.
When the imperial fortune was first established, he was plucked up — sacrifice officer and chief clerk, both in the former dynasty's chancellor offices.
Chinese 皇運初基，便蒙抽擢，祭酒主簿，竝皆先朝相府 is not the coarse-cloth career summary of s0206; the proposed idiomatic accurately renders the early-Qi promotion and former-dynasty chancellor posts.
